findings.summary: _commit_is_ancestor repeats the git merge-base --is-ancestor probe already implemented at reckon/velocity.py:706, reckon/crew/merge.py:610, reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2563 and reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:209; the tri-state fault policy and the read-pass cache belong on one owner rather than in a further copy.
_newest_by_plan_commit and _records_oldest_first (line 1116) both declare a plan_slug argument that neither body reads, so the signature claims a selection the body does not make.

the --review-run search at line 2786 is unreachable when read_plan_review returns no covering review, because the pre-existing 'no stored review' refusal fires first, so the plan's 'any stored review of the plan' promise holds only while some covering review exists.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: The node goal is that an answer lands on the stored plan review whose finding it names, chosen by plan commit order; `reckon/crew/plan_review.py:1089` `_newest_by_plan_commit` replaces both `plan_version` reductions and `reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:2786` widens the `--review-run` search to every stored review of the plan, so both clauses of the section are landed.
VERDICT done_when: The done_when names `tests/test_an_answer_lands_on_its_review.py` with the view case, the unnamed-answer case, the named-middle-review case and a `plan_version` negative control; the manifest records 3 failed at base 6bde1891, 3 passed at head 8ee31492 and 2 failed / 1 passed under the declared mutation, and each figure matches the summary line the cited log ends on.
VERDICT write_paths: The declared scope is `reckon/crew/plan_review.py`, `reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py`, `tests/test_an_answer_lands_on_its_review.py` and the evidence fragment under `docs/evidence/fragments/a-queued-request-is-checked-when-queued/; every path in the diff is inside it and no other file changed.
VERDICT manifest: Read; it records the literal gate command, logs ending in bare `EXIT=` lines, the negative control at 2 failed EXIT=1, and two population arms at 8 failed / 733 passed whose failure-id sets are identical file for file; it records no ruff log even though the done_when carries a ruff clause, so I ran `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` on the three staged source paths myself and both are clean (EXIT=0).
VERDICT diff: Read commit by commit from 6bde189128f94c26a95836eca1c994799549613f to 45d644e2fe44: `reckon/crew/plan_review.py` adds the selector helpers and swaps both version reductions for commit-order selection, `reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py` expands the named-review candidates, and the test and the evidence fragment are new files.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:2729, reckon/mcp_views.py:4504, reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:3979, reckon/crew/routing.py:2720, reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:673, reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py:2195
SCORE goal_fidelity: 18
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: `reckon/crew/plan_review.py:1427` reduces the covering set through `_newest_by_plan_commit` and `reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:2786` searches every stored review for the named finding, though the search sits behind the pre-existing `if record is None` refusal at `reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:2745`.
SCORE evidence: 16
JUSTIFICATION evidence: `tests/test_an_answer_lands_on_its_review.py:170` is the measured case and its base/head/negative-control/population logs are all on disk ending in a bare EXIT line, but the done_when's ruff clause has no recorded log in the run's `logs/` directory.
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: The four-commit diff touches only `reckon/crew/plan_review.py`, `reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py`, `tests/test_an_answer_lands_on_its_review.py` and the one permitted evidence fragment.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: `tests/test_an_answer_lands_on_its_review.py:188` asserts `record["review_run_id"] == NEWEST_RUN` against a module constant the code under test is never handed, and the declared mutation reinstating the `plan_version` reduction reddens it as `negative-control.txt` shows (2 failed, EXIT=1).
SCORE fit: 15
JUSTIFICATION fit: The helpers at `reckon/crew/plan_review.py:1011`-`1130` follow the module's private-helper style and carry no plan labels, but `_newest_by_plan_commit` and `_records_oldest_first` declare a `plan_slug` parameter neither body reads.
SCORE reuse: 6
JUSTIFICATION reuse: `reckon/crew/plan_review.py:1016` `_commit_is_ancestor` is another private copy of the git ancestry probe the repository already owns at `reckon/velocity.py:706` and duplicates at `reckon/crew/merge.py:610`, `reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2563` and `reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:209`, rather than extending one owner.
FINDING reckon/crew/plan_review.py:1016 non-blocking: `_commit_is_ancestor` repeats the `git merge-base --is-ancestor` probe already implemented at `reckon/velocity.py:706`, `reckon/crew/merge.py:610`, `reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2563` and `reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:209`; the tri-state fault policy and the read-pass cache are real differences but they belong on one owner, and every further copy is another place a policy change must be repeated.
FINDING reckon/crew/plan_review.py:1089 non-blocking: `_newest_by_plan_commit` and `_records_oldest_first` (line 1116) both take a `plan_slug` argument that neither body reads, so the signature claims the slug selects a policy when it does not.
FINDING reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:2745 non-blocking: the `--review-run` search at `reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:2786` is unreachable when `read_plan_review` returns no covering review, because `if record is None` refuses before the candidate expansion, so the plan's promise that `--review-run` naming any stored review of the plan writes to it holds only while some covering review exists.
